scripts.check: npm run check:ts && npm run check:py
scripts.check:ts: biome check . && npm run build -w @syraa/memory && npm run build -w @syraa/context && npm run build -w @syraa/ingest && npm run build -w @syraa/harness && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check:py: bash scripts/dev/python.sh -m ruff check . && bash scripts/dev/python.sh -m ruff format --check .
scripts.format: npm run format:ts && npm run format:py
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && bash scripts/dev/python.sh -m pytest
scripts.db:migrate: bash scripts/dev/with-env.sh npm run db:migrate -w @syraa/memory && bash scripts/dev/with-env.sh npm run db:migrate -w @syraa/context
